pages.title: svaagat hai
pages.content:
varsabaitals: diiman chez kyaa hai?

varsabaitals: diiman chez ek ekshan gem hai jahaan aap baaibal ke vachan siikhakar aatmik shatruon se larate hain. daanav aapako kaalakotharii ke kamaron men piichhaa karate hain.

aapakaa hathiyaar? parameshvar kaa vachan. apane hamalon ko shakti dene aur daanavon ko haraane ke lie vachan-prashnottarii kaa sahii uttar den.

pro tip: pahale vachan siikhen!

jiit kaa rahasy apane vachanon ko jaananaa hai. yuddh se pahale vachanon kaa adhyayan aur manan karane ke lie sunahare "yahaan vachan siikhen!" batan kaa upayog karen. aap parameshvar ke vachan ko jitanaa adhik jaanenge, utane hii adhik shaktishaalii banenge!

pages.title: lakshy aur chaal
pages.content:
lakshy

aage barhane ke lie pratyek star men paryaapt raakshason ko haraaen. isamen 5 star hain, pratyek pichhale se kathin hai. 5 maanachitr shailiyon men se chunen: klaasik kaalakotharii, sankare raaste, jatil bhuulabhulaiyaa, khule maidaan, aur grid sitii.

chalanaa

apane charitr ko vahaan le jaane ke lie gem kshetr men kahiin bhii taip yaa klik karen. aapakaa charitr svachaalit ruup se lakshy kii or chalataa hai.

aap galiyaaron se jure kaalakotharii ke kamaron se hokar gujarate hain. diivaaren aapakaa raastaa rokatii hain - khule raaste khojen!

pages.title: laraaii
pages.content:
haathaapaaii kii laraaii

jab aap kisii daanav ke kariib pahunchate hain, to laraaii svachaalit ruup se shuruu ho jaatii hai. aap aur daanav har 0.7 sekand men vaar karate hain.

  • aap keval tabhii nukasaan pahunchaate hain jab aapakaa pichhalaa prashnottarii uttar sahii thaa.
  • daanav hameshaa palatavaar karataa hai (jab tak aapake paas dhaal n ho).
  • pratyek daanav prakaar kaa adhikatam nukasaan alag hotaa hai.

golii chalaanaa

kisii daanav par prakshepy daagane ke lie us par taip karen. pratyek shot men 1 emo kharch hotaa hai. prashnottarii kaa sahii uttar dekar adhik emo kamaaen (pratyek sahii uttar par +5).

pages.title: baaibal vachan prashnottarii
pages.content:
prashnottarii kaise kaam karatii hai

skriin ke nichale bhaag men hameshaa ek baaibal vachan dikhaayaa jaataa hai jisamen kuchh shabd khaalii hote hain. gaayab shabdon ke sahii pahale akshar dikhaane vaale batan par taip karen.

yah kyon maayane rakhataa hai

  • sahii uttar: aapake haathaapaaii ke hamale nukasaan pahunchaate hain, aur aap +5 emo kamaate hain.
  • galat uttar: aapake hamale tab tak kuchh nahin karate jab tak aap agalaa sahii nahin karate.

vachan shreniyaan

vachan vishvaas, saahas aur prem jaisii shreniyon dvaaraa samuuhit kie gae hain. shrenii chayanakartaa kholane aur yah chunane ke lie ki aap kin vachanon kaa adhyayan karanaa chaahate hain, skriin ke shiirsh par shrenii ke naam par taip karen.

pages.title: sanbaddhataa sahaayataa
pages.content:
gunon kaa daanavon se milaan karen

aapakii vartamaan yuddh gunavattaa prabhaavit karatii hai ki aap pratyek daanav prakaar ko kitanaa nukasaan pahunchaate hain. kuchh joriyaan bahut adhik maar karatii hain, aur kuchh thorii kamajor hotii hain.

  • vishvaas bhay, sandeh aur avishvaas ke khilaaph majabuut hai.
  • changaaii durbalataa ke khilaaph sabase achchhii hai aur avasaad ke khilaaph madad karatii hai.
  • buddhi bhram, dhokhe aur ajnyaanataa ke khilaaph achchhaa kaam karatii hai.

ek ran ke dauraan, haimabargar menuu kholen aur puurn milaan gaaid dekhane ke lie sanbaddhataa sahaayataa par taip karen.

pages.title: saamaan - bhaag 1
pages.content:
svaasthy bindu

kaalakotharii men hare kros dikhaaii dete hain. 25 svaasthy bahaal karane ke lie un par chalen. ek samay men adhikatam 2 maujuud hote hain.

vishvaas kii dhaal

pratyek star par ek sunaharaa hiiraa ek baar dikhaaii detaa hai. ise apanii inventrii men ikatthaa karane ke lie us par chalen.

  • apanii inventrii kholane ke lie i batan (uupar-baaen) par taip karen.
  • dhaal ko sakriy karane ke lie upayog karen par taip karen.
  • sakriy hone par (10 sekand), aapako daanavon se shuuny nukasaan hotaa hai.
  • ek sunaharii chamak aapake charitr ko gher letii hai aur ek taaimar shesh samay dikhaataa hai.

pages.title: saamaan - bhaag 2
pages.content:
parameshvar kaa kavach

parameshvar ke kavach ke tukare ikatthaa karen jaise ve kaalakotharii men dikhaaii dete hain:

  • aatmaa kii talavaar - haathaapaaii ke nukasaan men vriddhi.
  • saty kaa kamaraband - atirikt surakshaa.
  • uddhaar kaa helamet - atirikt svaasthy.
  • dhaarmikataa kaa kavach - nukasaan men kamii.
  • shaanti ke saindal - chaal gati men vriddhi.

pages.title: khilaarii kii pragati
pages.content:
star barhaanaa

daanavon ko maarane se pratyek par 10 XP milataa hai. jaise-jaise aap XP praapt karate hain, aapakaa khilaarii star barhataa hai:

  • uchch star = adhik adhikatam svaasthy.
  • star barhane par puurn svaasthy bahaalii.

pages.title: gem ke star
pages.content:
isamen 5 gem star hain. aage barhane ke lie 60% raakshason ko haraaen:

  • star 1 (patthar kii kaalakotharii): bhay aur ajnyaanataa - dhiime, kamajor.
  • star 2 (prithvii kii kaalakotharii): kalah, bhram aur durbalataa - tej, adhik maarak.
  • star 3 (kristal kaalakotharii): nindaa, avishvaas, avasaad aur sandeh - tej, khataranaak.
  • star 4 (chhaayaa kaalakotharii): abhimaan, sustii kii aatmaa aur iizebel - vishesh kshamataaon ke saath majabuut.
  • star 5 (inpharno kaalakotharii): sabhii daanav prakaar - barhate HP ke saath antim chunautii.

pratyek star ek alag rang thiim ke saath ek nayaa kaalakotharii leaaut utpann karataa hai.

pages.title: sujhaav
pages.content:
shiirsh sujhaav

  • pahale apane vachan siikhen! vachanon kaa adhyayan aur manan karane ke lie sunahare "yahaan vachan siikhen!" batan par taip karen - unhen achchhii tarah jaananaa lagaataar jiitane kii kunjii hai.
  • kisii daanav se jurane se pahale pahale prashnottarii kaa uttar den - anyathaa aapake hamale kuchh nahin karate.
  • galiyaaron kaa apane phaayade ke lie upayog karen - daanav diivaaron par phans sakate hain.
  • apane vishvaas kii dhaal ko kaii piichhaa karane vaalon ke saath kathin laraaiyon ke lie bachaa kar rakhen.
  • haathaapaaii men jaane se pahale dushmanon ko kamajor karane ke lie duur se golii maaren.
  • apane emo kaauntar par nazar rakhen - stok men bane rahane ke lie prashnottarii kaa uttar dete rahen.

pages.title: daanav kshamataaen
pages.content:
daanav prakaar

  • piichhaa karane vaale - aapakaa lagaataar piichhaa karate hain.
  • bhatakane vaale - betaratiib dhang se chalate hain, lekin yadi aap kariib aate hain to bhii chot pahunchaate hain.

vishesh kshamataaen (baad ke star)

  • phriijing oraa - paas hone par aapakii chaal ko dhiimaa kar detaa hai.
  • abhimaan kavach - tuutane tak lie gae nukasaan ko kam karataa hai.
  • spirit dren - hit hone par aapakaa emo churaa letaa hai.
  • kalah daish - gati ke ek jhatake ke saath aap par hamalaa karataa hai.

shubhakaamanaaen, aur vachan aapakii talavaar bane!
